# 207 Studio

> Apps from 207 Studio (207studio.dev), an independent software studio in South Korea.

Founder: Jang Yuil (장유일)

## Apps

- [Pairy: Connecting Devices](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815584225): Remote desktop for your tablet. Shows your computer's screen on your tablet and lets you control it with touch, trackpad and keyboard. Paid app, one-time purchase ($4.99 in the US).

## In development

- Chalkieboard: an iPad app for classroom presentation and annotation, designed around the materials teachers already use.
- CheckyBoard: a Python-based application for exam authoring, grading and analysis, bringing related assessment tasks into one workflow.
- StoneWars: a five-in-a-row board game for iPhone and iPad, where every stone is a small character with its own look.

## Writing

- [How to play a PPTX in the browser (without PowerPoint)](https://207studio.dev/blog/play-pptx-in-browser/): Render a .pptx in the browser without a server or Office. What breaks the animations, three ways to do it, and how to test any viewer in five minutes.

## 한국어

- [207스튜디오 홈](https://207studio.dev/ko/): 대한민국의 독립 소프트웨어 스튜디오. 앱과 도구를 만들어요.
- [소개](https://207studio.dev/ko/about/): 207 Studio가 무엇을 만드는지, 어떻게 문의하는지.
- [글](https://207studio.dev/ko/blog/): 브라우저 렌더링과 교실 도구에 관한 글.
